# function: multi_replace_sequential

Uses a list of objects to replace multiple substrings in a string sequentially, preserving the order of the list.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
multi_replace_sequential(input string, replacements list of object) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `input` (String) The string in which to replace substrings
1. `replacements` (List of Object) The list of replacements to apply in order. Each replacement is an object with 'from' and 'to' attributes.
